doc.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing remarks
summary: Brown asks for closing thoughts and Marsalis, tired, has none.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Right on the money. Anything else you want to say as closing? Anything? This is the historical record. We’ve got it for as long as – in perpetuity.
I don’t know. No. I’m so doggone tired.
